text: The public historical patch changes security.sandbox.content.level from4to5 only for Linux under MOZ_SANDBOX. Fixed accepted source retains5. This does not show the effect of sandbox level5 or any effective runtime protection. Bugzilla is Access Denied and the Custom Policy review was deliberately unread. Rationale and compatibility outcomes remain unknown; zero complete-audit credit.
title: The May2025 Linux sandbox default changes only its platform branch
